Project description
FireFront 3D brings wildfire footage, camera views, and investigation evidence into one workspace.
Its Python agent connects questions to timestamped evidence; the current demo uses fixtures while live integration remains pending.
We use Cursor to develop the application.
VAST Data provides incident video storage, metadata management, and retrieval.
NVIDIA Cosmos provides video descriptions and embeddings through the existing VAST pipeline
